servinfo.title: Rear Planetary Gear Assembly and One-Way Clutch Assembly Disassembly and Reassembly

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Front Planetary Gear Assembly and Input Shaft Components

s1.ptxt: Remove rear planetary carrier thrust washer No.1 (1).
Remove rear planetary carrier thrust washer No.2 (1).
Remove rear planetary sun gear No.1 (1), rear planetary sun gear No.1 thrust bearing (2) and rear planetary sun gear No.1 thrust bearing race (3).

Remove rear planetary sun gear No.2 (1), rear planetary sun gear No.2 thrust bearing race No.1 (2), rear planetary sun gear No.2 thrust bearing (3) and Rear planetary sun gear No.2 thrust bearing race No.2 (4).

servinfosub.title: Reassembly

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Rear Planetary Gear Assembly and One-Way Clutch Assembly Related Parts Inspection

servinfosub.ptxt: Reverse disassembly procedure noting the following point.

item.ptxt: Install thrust bearing, thrust bearing race and thrust washer in correct direction referring to “Thrust Bearing, Thrust Bearing Race and Thrust Washer” under A/T Assembly Components .
